Description
Employment Type: Full-Time
Workplace: Remote
Compensation:  $90,000-$110,000 annually, with flexibility based on geography and experience.

About Us

HireHawk connects skilled professionals with career opportunities at U.S. and Canadian companies. For this search, we’re supporting a growing organization that is turning internally developed tools and manual workflows into reliable software. Its technical team is making systems easier to maintain and knowledge easier to share, so essential processes no longer depend on one person.

About the Role

This opportunity welcomes recent Computer Science graduates and junior engineers, giving you meaningful work on real systems while helping establish the team’s engineering practices. You’ll work directly with the tech lead and spend your first 2-3 months shadowing the current Data Engineer as they transition into Program Management, building the context to improve pipelines, software quality, and documentation.

The schedule is Monday-Friday across U.S. time zones, with Pacific Time collaboration preferred and flexibility nationwide.

Several weeks of temporary in-person onboarding in Chicago during December and January might apply.

Requirements

Must-Have:

A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science.
Strong foundations in software engineering principles, algorithms, and data structures.
Demonstrated programming ability through academic projects, personal projects, internships, or professional work. Previous professional experience is not required.
Ability to understand existing code, troubleshoot problems, and apply foundational testing, debugging, and code-quality practices.
Clear technical communication and documentation skills, including a willingness to ask questions and work through problems with others.
Ability to work independently, follow through carefully, and learn unfamiliar technologies as processes and systems evolve.
Residence in the United States and availability to begin employment as soon as possible.

Nice to Have:

Hands-on Python projects involving scripting, automation, or data processing.
Familiarity with SQL, relational databases, ETL/ELT pipelines, APIs, or system integrations.
Exposure to Git, unit or integration testing, CI/CD concepts, or Agile/Scrum development practices.
Basic understanding of secure software development or SOC 2 principles.
Experience using AI-assisted development tools responsibly, including reviewing, understanding, and testing generated code.
Benefits
Flexible/unlimited paid time off
Employer-paid healthcare
A 401(k) plan
Discretionary bonuses and opportunities for salary increases.
An initial 2-3 months learning directly from the current Data Engineer, alongside collaboration with the tech lead.
